segments.text: Ok so, this is the A two UI page for Google Antigravity, and I have implemented it in my project.
This is my project, this is the code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. So I asked for a quick sales KPI dashboard.
And no dashboard renders at all, I only get text or an error back.
On the doc, the catalog passed in here is never defined.
So basically, the page only shows fragments. My catalog isn't defined and no agent is named, so umm, I had to guess the setup.
And even with that, no A two UI dashboard ever renders.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
